decisions.reason: As a module that builds directly on our established postpress portfolio and still merits its own webpage in 2024, it remains a low-cost, strategically aligned option whose market value is not yet fully resolved, so we keep it open.

Because this folding add-on extends an existing system, is still being promoted in 2024, and already shows a reference installation with clear process benefits, we would keep it on the market since the option value exceeds the limited cost of continuation.
